description: [Requires sign-in] Check whether personal AI agents can reach a product URL, understand it, and reach checkout. Runs ARC's readiness check: crawler access, whether an agent can answer a shopper's questions from the page, and personal shopping agents trying to add to cart or reach checkout. Returns a check id — poll get_readiness_result (about 30–60 seconds). This does not ask what agents think of the brand; use ask_agents_about_brand for that.

task.description: Optional goal, e.g. 'add to cart' (default) or 'reach checkout'.

url.description: The product or store URL to test, e.g. https://store.com/products/best-seller

name: check_agent_readiness
